mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events (event_id, group_id, activity_id, aggregate_id, type, payload, generation, policy_revision, occurred_at, delivered_at, sync_delivered_at, attempts) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{groupId}, #{activityId}, #{aggregateId}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{generation}, #{policyRevision}, #{occurredAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{attempts})
mapper.select: SELECT assigned.sequence, event.event_id, event.group_id, event.activity_id, event.aggregate_id, event.type, event.payload, event.generation, event.policy_revision, event.occurred_at, event.delivered_at, event.attempts FROM sync_event_sequences assigned JOIN outbox_events event ON event.event_id=assigned.event_id WHERE assigned.sequence > #{cursor} ORDER BY assigned.sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT assigned.sequence, event.event_id, event.group_id, event.activity_id, event.aggregate_id, event.type, event.payload, event.generation, event.policy_revision, event.occurred_at, event.delivered_at, event.attempts FROM sync_event_sequences assigned JOIN outbox_events event ON event.event_id=assigned.event_id WHERE event.delivered_at IS NULL AND event.sync_delivered_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY assigned.sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT assigned.sequence, event.event_id, event.group_id, event.activity_id, event.aggregate_id, event.type, event.payload, event.generation, event.policy_revision, event.occurred_at, event.delivered_at, event.attempts FROM sync_event_sequences assigned JOIN outbox_events event ON event.event_id=assigned.event_id WHERE event.sync_delivered_at IS NULL ORDER BY assigned.sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT assigned.sequence, event.event_id, event.group_id, event.activity_id, event.aggregate_id, event.type, event.payload, event.generation, event.policy_revision, event.occurred_at, event.delivered_at, event.attempts FROM sync_event_sequences assigned JOIN outbox_events event ON event.event_id=assigned.event_id WHERE event.delivered_at IS NULL AND event.sync_delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND (event.external_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR event.external_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(event.external_next_attempt_at, event.occurred_at), assigned.sequence LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET delivered_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE outbox_events SET sync_delivered_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE outbox_events SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

UPDATE outbox_events SET attempts = attempts + 1, external_attempts = LEAST(external_attempts, 30) + 1, external_next_attempt_at = #{failedAt}::timestamptz + make_interval(secs => LEAST(60, power(2, LEAST(external_attempts, 5) + 1))::integer) WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
